title: Foundry reconciliation manifest (.foundry/reconciliation.yaml)
description: Atom F (#122, feat-foundry-merge-reconcile-fast-path). A build MAY carry this manifest to declare an EXPLICIT rename-map for the merge-gate's mechanical-reconcile fast-path (never inferred). The gate PROVES the declared map against the frozen system_grounding block + the HEAD live snapshot (scripts/foundry_reconcile.py's 5-clause predicate); a manifest failing THIS schema BLOCKs the merge (fail-closed, AC-MRF-1).

reconciliation.description: The declared rename-map + its human-readable justification.

renames.description: Each entry is an EXPLICIT old_identifier -> new_identifier rename the build asserts is a pure mechanical rename of a system_grounding identifier. The gate proves — never infers — the map (Alembic/Django declared-rename discipline).

kind.description: MUST equal both the old identifier's actual kind in the frozen system_grounding block and the new identifier's actual kind in the head snapshot (predicate clause 3).

old_identifier.description: The identifier as declared in the frozen system_grounding block. Must have disappeared from the head snapshot (predicate clause 1).

new_identifier.description: The identifier as it now appears in the head snapshot. Must be absent from the frozen system_grounding block (predicate clause 2).

provenance.description: The migration/reason for the rename (e.g. a migration file name or a one-line justification). Recorded verbatim in the reconcile banner + the durable record (AC-MRF-5).
